regime_context: The absolute-trend gate has validated drawdown-control value on this market's history (gate_helps true), so trend discipline matters most; but cross-sectional momentum, rotation timing, and crowding all carry no predictive edge. Leadership is broad (9/16 themes eligible) with Gold Miners and Silver & Royalties at the top on rank but only middling durability (0.66/0.63) and mixed Hurst tags, so this is regime context rather than a directional signal.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Silver & Royalties closes the 0.173 score gap to Gold Miners AND its breadth holds above 0.90 for five consecutive sessions — that would mark a confirmed internal handoff within precious metals rather than a new narrative; retire the watch if the gap widens back above 0.4.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners sits atop the rank (1.8) with broad participation (breadth 0.933) and is not crowded (z 0.54), so the trend-gate says staying with the leader is the lower-drawdown posture—not a call that it will outperform. Given the track record's weak directional accuracy (0.372), any positive lean is a low-conviction, trend-respect stance.
evidence: gate_helps true — validate staying with eligible leaders to reduce drawdown

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties

Low conviction because rank near the top is attention, not alpha.
evidence: trend-gate perspective: eligibility broad, favor confirmed leaders over mean-reversion laggards
theses.dissent: Silver historically amplifies both directions; a mean-revert tag elsewhere (Base Metals 0.51, hurst mean-revert) warns the whole metals complex could whipsaw, and silver's rank edge over gold is thin.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO proxy for silver-royalty breaks below its own 50-day moving average while the TSX holds flat

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks holds rank 5 (0.75) with a trend Hurst tag and decent durability (0.66) but very weak breadth (0.429), so the leadership is narrow. Given no momentum edge and a mean-return-less trend gate, avoiding the mid-pack in favor of confirmed broad leaders is the vol-aware posture.
evidence: backtest verdict: absolute gate lower vol/drawdown but no mean-return edge
theses.dissent: Banks are deeply value-priced and rate-sensitive; a steepening curve or positive macro surprise could lift the whole Financials complex sharply, and avoiding them may sacrifice upside.
